summary_for_children: Al-Falaq teaches seeking refuge in the Lord of daybreak from evil, darkness and envy.
environment_concept: A ridge facing the eastern horizon as daybreak comes, and a low hollow below it where the evening shadow settles. Lanterns light the hollow. No person, magic or envier is shown.
architecture_and_scenery: Ridge-top lookout with low stone seats, a shaded hollow with lanterns.

areas.name: Daybreak Ridge
areas.description: A ridge where the sun is rising over the horizon, for reading 113:1.

areas.name: Settling Darkness
areas.description: A hollow where shadow gathers, lit by small lanterns you can light.

activities.name: Read the five
activities.description: Put the five ayahs of Al-Falaq in order.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Match each place to its ayah
activities.description: Match the ridge and the hollow to the ayah each comes from.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Light the hollow
activities.description: Tap the three lanterns in the hollow to light them.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

status.playable_environment: first version built: its own scene (a daybreak ridge and a shaded hollow with lanterns to light), two playable games and one activity played in the scene
status.testing: checked in headless Chromium with software WebGL at 1280x800; not tested on phones or real GPUs
status.tested_by: automated screenshots of the scene and the games

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
